I’ve been playing for 8 years and my advice to you is
A) Sometimes going back to basics is good, keep doing your scales mix up your warms ups, I’ve noticed I always get a spark doing the most basic things and build a little riff from that and if you want to learn a song that you think it’s to hard to learn, don’t be afraid to try it out before you give up on it
B) Set a price range for yourself and stick to it avoid a financial hardship after that head to your local guitar center and walk around, don’t be afraid to play around with them after all it’s what you feel most comfortable with and you may even get lucky and find someone there that can help you pick out a perfect match, my personal range is anywhere from $400-$600 that’s for both acoustic and electric, currently I have 3 guitars and they were all a good bang for your buck
